correctness.rationale: Reconstructed coefficients from the primary theorem by closed-form sums over exactly specified integer intervals for both coprime residue classes. The resulting quartic is exact; three polynomial components are proved strictly positive on x>=-2 via rational Bernstein/shift certificates. Shift t=-x-2 has signs (+,+,-,-,+); two distinct sign crossings and Descartes yield precisely two simple negative transformed roots, with the remaining conjugate pair nonreal and simple. Reciprocal quadratic lifting gives four simple interior zeros. Puiseux-type rescaling at x=0,-2 and ordinary simple-root expansion at x=-4 give the stated coefficients, independently checked by exact symbolic identities; asymptotic remainders follow the implicit function theorem.

value.rationale: The rational Hartogs family tends toward the zero-free classical Hartogs triangle as the slope tends to one. Complete classification of the number and type of moving diagonal numerator roots, and discovery that one real and two conjugate roots hit the boundary at different universal sharp speeds while one remains trapped, provides concrete degeneration geometry beyond the already known count. Explicit formulas enable further analysis of kernel zero varieties and parameter limits; this is neither an arbitrary parameter tweak nor mere recomputation of gap-four nonvanishing.
